out_items.name: Toxic substances properly identified, stored, and used

violations.corrective_action: All employees' personal care items shall be stored in a way that prevents the contamination of food and food contact surfaces through improper labeling or storage. PIC moved personal care items so they were not being stored over food contact surfaces

out_items.name: Single-use/single-service articles properly stored and used

violations.title: Single-Service/Use Items No Reuse
violations.observation: Manufacturer containers were observed reused for the storage of various spices throughout the kitchen
violations.corrective_action: Manufacturer containers may not be reused for secondary storage of other foods because the containers are not durable enough for multiple reuse and become uncleanable. PIC agreed to stop re-using single use manufacturer containers

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.corrective_action: Non-food contact surfaces of equipment that are exposed to splash, spillage, or other foods that require frequent cleaning shall be constructed of a corrosion- resistant, nonabsorbent, and smooth material.
